key_steps: Extract Total Depth Date from boreholes data
Identify WAR records for each API before TD date
Apply gap threshold (300 days) to handle drilling interruptions
Adjust spud date based on gap analysis
Calculate drilling days as (TD_DATE - ADJUSTED_SPUD_DATE) - early_days
business_rules: If gap > 300 days, restart drilling timeline from after gap
Early drilling days before major gaps are subtracted from total
Only use WAR records that start before Total Depth Date
data_filtering: Filter WAR records by lease numbers
Remove records with missing WAR_START_DT or WAR_END_DT
Sort WAR records by start date for timeline analysis

completion_days_calculation.approach: Post-TD WAR timeline analysis with gap handling
key_steps: Find WAR records after Total Depth Date for each well
Apply smaller gap threshold (8 days) for completion activities
Group consecutive WAR activities into completion segments
Sum duration of all completion segments
business_rules: Only analyze WAR records after Total Depth Date
Multiple completion segments are summed together
If no WAR records after TD, completion days = 0
segment_logic: Break completion timeline at gaps > 8 days
Calculate days for each continuous segment
Sum all segment durations for total completion days
